question: In humans, what are the pharmacokinetics of emicizumab and their association with efficacy in haemophilia A?
source: SYNERGY dataset Donners_2021; 'Pharmacokinetics and Associated Efficacy of Emicizumab in Humans' (Clin Pharmacokinet 2021, doi:10.1007/s40262-021-01042-w); gold = label_included==1 rows with DOI via [AID]
notes: Created with make_fixture.py. No baseline strategy: use evals/generate.py (Phase 2). Harness reports reachable vs. unreachable gold separately.

version_change.decision_source: Evaluation fixture author; scope derived from the source systematic review.

review.question: In humans, what are the pharmacokinetics of emicizumab and their association with efficacy in haemophilia A?

framework.name: Drug review (drug x population x pharmacokinetics/efficacy)
framework.rationale: A single-drug pharmacokinetics review. Emicizumab is a rare, specifically named agent, so the drug itself is the one essential retrieval concept; the pharmacokinetics and efficacy outcomes and the human context are screening-only, because pure prophylaxis/efficacy trials that also report PK would be dropped by an outcome block.

slots.label: Drug
slots.description: Emicizumab (development names ACE910, factor VIII-mimetic bispecific antibody; brand Hemlibra).

inclusion.label: Emicizumab
inclusion.description: The study concerns emicizumab (or its development names ACE910 / factor VIII-mimetic bispecific antibody).

inclusion.label: In humans
inclusion.description: Conducted in humans (persons with haemophilia A, including healthy-volunteer bridging studies).

inclusion.label: Pharmacokinetics and/or efficacy
inclusion.description: Reports pharmacokinetics/exposure and/or associated efficacy (bleeding-rate) data.

inclusion.label: Clinical / PK study
inclusion.description: A clinical trial, pharmacokinetic, or pharmacometric study.

exclusion.label: No PK or efficacy data
exclusion.description: Reports neither pharmacokinetic nor efficacy outcomes.

concepts.label: Emicizumab
concepts.definition: The drug under review: emicizumab, including its development identifiers (ACE910) and descriptor 'factor VIII-mimetic bispecific antibody' and brand name Hemlibra. Retrieval must not depend on the single term 'emicizumab', since early studies used ACE910 / factor VIII-mimetic wording.
concepts.rationale: A single stable essential concept: emicizumab is a rare, specifically named agent used only in haemophilia A, so the drug alone is a high-sensitivity yet precise anchor. Its development names must be included so first-in-human studies are not missed.

properties.label: Pharmacokinetics / exposure
properties.instructions: Confirm at screening that pharmacokinetics/exposure (or associated efficacy) is reported. Do not add a pharmacokinetics AND block.
properties.recall_rationale: Prophylaxis/efficacy trials that also report PK often do not carry 'pharmacokinetics' in the abstract; a PK block would drop them.

properties.label: Human study
properties.instructions: Confirm at screening that human data are reported. Apply no species search limit.
properties.recall_rationale: A species limit/hedge can drop first-in-human and bridging studies that are indexed inconsistently.

properties.label: Clinical / PK / pharmacometric design
properties.instructions: Confirm at screening that the study is a clinical trial, PK, or pharmacometric study. Apply no methodological filter.
properties.recall_rationale: Study-type filters miss pharmacometric and population-PK analyses; screen for design instead.

decisions.label: Methodological (study-design) filter
decisions.rationale: Recall-first evaluation build; species and study design are confirmed at screening, not by a search-time hedge.

decisions.label: Database limits
decisions.rationale: No language, age, species, publication-status, or date limits for the recall-first evaluation build.

date_boundaries.rationale: No date boundaries; the evaluation scores against a fixed gold set.

recall.policy: Recall first; decline the optional no-seed heuristic during evaluation because hidden gold is scored independently.

workload.policy: Do not narrow solely because retrieval is large.
workload.selection_rule: Workload may choose only among variants that meet the held-out recall requirement.

protocol_status: tightened; lock-validated and compiled. Single-concept scope (emicizumab incl. ACE910/factor VIII-mimetic synonyms) recalls 15/15 gold at ~0.9k hits.
